build_comment_prompt: build a local or whole-document Feishu comment prompt from doc metadata, timeline entries, and referenced documents
run_comment_agent: run an AIAgent with feishu_doc and feishu_drive tools to generate a reply for a Feishu document comment
handle_drive_comment_event: handle a Feishu drive comment_add_v1 event by parsing, fetching context, running an agent, and delivering the reply
add_comment_reaction: add an emoji reaction to a Feishu document comment reply via the Drive v2 reaction API
deliver_comment_reply: route an agent-generated reply to the correct Feishu comment API with chunking and fallback support
